snippet.title: Craftlings Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Craftlings are as diligent as they are hapless, and it's up to your keen strategic mind and refined sense of resource management to channel these creatures' focused energy into something productive and prevent them from plunging off the nearest cliff in their attempt to build their settlement. 

Check out the new demo on Steam, and wishlist today!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1771110/Craftlings/
